# MotoWorth

MotoWorth is an India-focused buyer-side used-bike valuation and listing-analysis tool.

Primary tasks:
- Estimate a buyer-side used-bike price range.
- Set an opening offer, target close and walk-away ceiling.
- Estimate an immediate repair reserve.
- Analyse a marketplace listing using asking price and bike details.
- Explain negotiation strategy for owner vs dealer sellers.

Data policy:
- Source-backed reference records retain source, date, price basis and confidence.
- Catalogue-only records are not treated as verified market quotes.
- Used-market asking prices are separate from new-bike reference prices.
- Dealer status does not inflate intrinsic bike value.

Website: https://www.motoworth.com/
